title: NewDays
description:
Step off the beaten path and into the heart of Tokyo’s vibrant food scene. You’re not going to just tasting Japanese cuisine—you’re diving into a cultural experience designed for true food lovers.
Join our intimate, small-group tour led by a friendly, English-speaking local expert. Wander through authentic neighborhoods rarely visited by tourists, and enjoy exclusive access to hidden eateries, cozy izakayas, and family-run gems known only to locals.

・8-10 authentic Japanese dishes and 3 drinks include Sake at 3 eateries for fresh sea food , Wagyu and more ...

・Receive personalized attention on an intimate small-group tour with fluent English speaker guide 

・Avoid touristy places and get into hidden gems which you barely find it .

This is not just a authentic Japanese food tour but also a chance to engage with friendly local guide and get to know what exactly Japanese culture and cuisine is .

title: toks 学芸大学改札口
description:
If you’re looking for a truly exclusive dining experience in Tokyo, this premium tour takes you to members only restaurants that usually don’t welcome walk in guests.
The owner chef Hasegawa has four different type of restaurants and this is his one and only Omakase dining which he can provide his skills face to face.
This tour includes eight courses, including dessert and two drinks. A sommelier will guide you through choosing drinks, either alcoholic or non alcoholic, depending on your preference. Various types of Japanese sake, fresh fruit sour and Japanese tea cocktails and mocktails are among the offerings. Sip these delicious refreshments along with your spectacular food in an evening you won’t forget!

Inclusions
Eight dishes and two drinks at the first restaurant
One drink at the second restaurant
High quality pictures taken by the photographer guide during the tour 
Tips about food, drinks and travel around Japan

title: Giant Halloween Pumpkins 2021 at Yumenoshima | Halloween Pumpkins | Halloween Party | ハロウィンパーティー2021
description:
#yumenoshimahalloweenparty2021 #halloweenpumpkins #halloweenintokyo #halloween2021

Welcome back to Yumenoshima tropical greenhouse dome. As you can see on our last posted video, Daddy and i were here and we enjoyed much with the tropical plants in the dome. And since Jt was not with us that day, we went back here today and we will be enjoying with the giant halloween pumpkins. 

An exhibition of these giant ghost pumpkins, which they call Yumenoshima halloween party, is celebrated and very popular every year. And since the halloween is just around the corner, this event is already happening right now. It started on the 22nd of September and will last until the 31st of October. 

They will exhibit more than 100 giant ghost pumpkins weighing 50 to 100 kilograms. Can you imagine how heavy and big is that? These giant pumpkins were made in Hitachiomiya City, in Ibaraki Prefecture, in connection with the Halloween. 

With an admission fee of 250 yen for each adult, you can roam around the greenhouse dome, learn and enjoy the tropical plants which you barely see everyday. Kids under 12 years old can enter free of charge. And for sure your toddlers will have fun with these giant ghost pumpkins all around the open garden. There will also be a photography area just inside the hall with the halloween backdrops. So you better grab your favorite halloween costumes and get ready for memorable photos.

You can also bring your own food and have a small picnic in the garden together with these ghost pumpkins, orrr, you can just go to the cafeteria inside the hall and grab any food of your choice.

Event Date and Hours: 
September 22– Sunday,Tuesday–Sunday  9:30 – 17:00 (Last entry 16:00). Closed on Monday. If Monday is a public holiday they will open and close on Tuesday.

Cost: Fees: Adults 250 yen, Ages 65 and older 120 yen, Ages 13–15 100 yen
Under 12 FREE!

Address: 2-1-2 Yumenoshima, Koto-ku
Phone: 03-3522-0281
Website: http://www.yumenoshima.jp/

Note: this is in Japanese language. You can use google chrome too as it has an automatic translator if you wish to view it in English.

Access: 10 minute walk from Shin-Kiba Station, which is 10 minutes from Tokyo Station on the Keiyo Line. Also accessible on the Yurakucho Line.

You can also access the Metro Tozai line’s Toyocho Station and take the Toei Bus going to Shinkiba, get off at the Yumenoshima Stop and from there you can walk 7mins to Greenhouse Dome.

Notes: Nursing room and Diaper changing table located in the Botanical Garden. Please ask the staff for directions.

title: Japan's tallest stone steps, 3333 steps　日本一の石段　3333段　釈迦院御坂遊歩道　英字幕付き　美里町観光PR動画
description:
This is a Misato Town tourism PR video created in 2025.

These stone steps were built in Misaka, the main approach to the historic Shaka-in Temple (Izumi-cho, Yatsushiro City), which has a history of 1,200 years, and are the largest in Japan.They will be preserved for future generations as a century-old cultural heritage and will revitalize the town. It was built with the aim of creating a tourist attraction and a symbol of town revitalization.
Construction of the stone steps began in January 1980, and in November 1986, it surpassed the 2,446 steps of Mt. Haguro in Yamagata Prefecture to become the number one in Japan in both name and reality, and was completed at the end of March 1986.
In addition to famous stones from all over the country, these stone steps use granite from countries around the world such as China, South Korea, India, the former Soviet Union, Brazil, the United States, and South Africa.They are used to build international goodwill and friendship, and to promote historical exploration and health. It is used as a tourist and recreational facility.
Additionally, Attack the Nihon Ichi is held every November using the stone steps.
Some early climbers may take less than an hour to complete the climb, but for the general public, please expect it to take about 3 hours, including 2 hours for the ascent and 1 hour for the descent.

title: Hiking in Japan - Sacred Peak Mt. Hakkai 八海山 | Adventures in Yukiguni | Minamiuonuma
description:
Climbing Mt. Hakkai (1778 m) of the Echigo Sanzan Mountains. Using the Hakkaisan Ropeway the hike took about 7 hours round-trip. 

Many tourists flock to Snow Country in the winter months to hit the slopes, but many of these snow resort grounds continue to attract visitors seeking outdoor adventures through mountain climbing in the summer as well. 

Mt. Hakkai is a famous mountain in Minamiuonuma that boasts a long history of dedicated climbers coming from all across the country. There are two impressive shrines dedicated to the mountain at each trail-head, and the mountain's delicious spring water and impressive shape are part of the reason its name has become one of Japan's most reputable sake brands: Hakkaisan. The mountain is very popular for tourists hiking on summer break and its lookout decks offer beautiful views of the varicolored Uonuma Basin in autumn once the leaves begin to change too. The mountains in this region are said to bless the locals with many gifts and in the green season these are manifested in the landscape's breathtaking scenery.

It is one of the remains of the Kumanobe Railway, which opened in April 1912 in Minami Kumamoto Station (Kumamoto City) and later extended to Toyo, Shimomashiki District (Misato Town), running for a total length of 28.6 km.
The line was discontinued in 1962, but even now, about 60 years later, this octagonal tunnel, which was built to prevent the rocks on both sides of the track from collapsing, still welcomes many tourists as an industrial ruin. I am.
A leading theory is that the reason why the seven towers are connected, with gaps between them, making it an imperfect shape for rockfall protection, is to reduce construction costs. It is a ruin with many mysteries.
Also, nearby are the piers of the Tsurugawa Bridge, which are also the remains of the Kumanobe Railway, and are valuable remains of the Kumanobe Railway, which supported industrial development in the past.

title: Mt. Io:Untouched Hokkaido/硫黄山
description:
Teshikaga Town: Mt. Io

Stand inches away from the pulse of the earth
With the distinctive smell of sulfur and alpine plants at much lower altitudes than they usually grow, Mt. Io is like a scene from another planet. Mt. Io is located around 3km from Kawayu Hot Springs, and is called Atosa-nupuri (bare mountain) in Ainu. To this day, sulfur plumes rise from various areas of the mountain, with an incredible rumbling sound. Large-scale sulfur mining once took place here, which played a significant role in Teshikaga Town's development.
Parking is free during the winter (late November to early April).
Parking fees apply during summer: \200 for a motorcycle, \500 for a car, \1,000 for a minibus, \2,000 for a large bus
*Mt. Io is currently closed to the public for safety reasons, as there is currently a risk of falling rocks.

title: Hike along the Akan River:Untouched Hokkaido/阿寒川リバーサイドハイク
description:
You’ll be hard-pressed to find a more beautiful hiking spot than this tranquil river surrounded by forest with natural hot springs along the way
The pure waters of the Akan River are home to rainbow trout and whitespotted char. In winter, you can hike on snowshoes through the snow-covered forest by the river. Hot springs can be found along the river, making the perfect end point for your hike. If the timing is right, you might even see wildlife such as foxes, raccoon dogs (tanuki) and Yezo deer, which drink from the hot springs to get minerals.

"Where water kamuy and fire kamuy meet"
The indigenous Ainu people of Hokkaido place great importance on coexisting with nature, where they believe that deities reside. There are two types of deities in nature – the deity of fire  (apefuchi-kamuy) and the deity of water (wakkaushi-kamuy). The Akan River is a holy ground where the two meet, and the two types of kamuy are believed to provide the nutrients that the forest wildlife lives on.

This natural open-air hot spring bath will make you feel like you’re bathing in Lake Kussharo itself
This hot spring bath surrounded by stones is just 5m from Lake Kussharo, creating the illusion that you are bathing in Lake Kussharo itself. In winter, the warm water runs into the lake, attracting swans that you can see right before your eyes. As you look out over the lake, you'll feel as if the swans are bathing in the hot spring with you. This vast natural paradise is stunningly beautiful no matter what time of day you visit, with incredible sunsets over the mountains beyond the lake and stars as far as the eye can see at night. Admission is free and free parking is available. Basic men's and women's changing facilities are available. The bath is surrounded by stones. While there is a large stone in the center dividing the bath in two, each side is visible from the other side, so bathing is basically mixed. Swimwear is OK.

title: Untouched Hokkaido ダイジェスト(Winter)
description:
Welcome to Eastern Hokkaido, an incredibly beautiful area filled with rare wildlife and natural wonders.
The area is blessed with an abundance of pure, natural water that transforms the landscape throughout the seasons. 

Sarorun Kamuy
The Kushiro area is home to the natural habitat of the red-crowned crane, a designated special natural monument that was once called “sarorun kamuy”, which means “spirits that live in the marshlands”, by the native Ainu people.

Cape Kirakotan
Cape Kirakotan is a designated national natural monument area, and its name originates from when the marshland was still part of the ocean, 6 thousand years ago. It was found to be a natural breeding ground of the red crowned crane that was previously thought to be extinct.

Sunset Cruise
Kushiro is said to have one of the three most beautiful sunsets in the world, and the best place to see it is from a boat. 

Robatayaki
Robatayaki is a style of cooking that is unique to the port town of Kushiro, and these restaurants are the perfect place to enjoy amazing food and delicious sake with friendly locals.

Sake : Fukutsukasa
Established in 1919, Fukutsukasa sake brewery blends delicious local spring water with the finest natural ingredients to create a wide variety of sakes.

Snowshoeing
Snowshoeing along the banks of Akan River brings you to a natural oasis that attracts many wild animals, a mystical place where the Ainu believed the spirits of fire and water coexist.

Ainu Culture
Ainu are the indigenous people of Hokkaido, who believe that spirits exist in nature. The culture and customs of the Ainu people remain strong in the Akan region.

Lake Kussharo
Lake Kussharo is the largest caldera lake in Japan and is home to a large number of wild swans that keep warm through the harsh winter near the natural hot springs.

Mt. Iou
Mt. Iou vents plumes of sulfurous steam through volcanic craters in the mountain side, creating a strong smell of sulfur in the surrounding area. 

Kawayu Hot Spring
Hotels in Kawayu Onsen area draw their hot spring water from the same pure source, so abundant that even the river that flows through the town stems from natural volcanic springs.

Lake Mashu
The lake water is so pure it is said to be the second clearest water in the world, and the lake surface has a distinctively beautiful color known as Mashu blue.

title: Narusawa Ice Cave | Mt. Fuji Tour | 鳴沢氷穴 | Narusawa Hyōketsu
description:
#narusawa #narusawaicecave #mtfuji #yamanashi #japanadventures #touristsppotsinjapan #familyadventureinjapan

The Narusawa "Hyoketsu" Ice Cave is located at the east entrance to the Aokigahara Jukai "sea of trees" forest, and is regarded as one of the tourist spots within the Fuji Five Lakes area that can be visited throughout the year.
Over 1150 years ago, during year 6 of the Jogan era (864 a.d.), Nagaoyama, a flank volcano of Mt. Fuji erupted. The red hot lava flow (Aokigahara Maruo) descended between ancient parasitic volcanoes, creating this two-tunnel type cave. After being designated by the Ministry of Education as a natural monument in 1929, it was introduced to the world as a geological wonder.
By the way, the tree-type lava bed is said to have the most spiracles in the world.

Since the cave is situated in a ring-like manner, visitors can view its various features by making one circular loop.

The average temperature inside the cave is 3degC, that's why it is called an Ice Cave. The total length of the cave is 150m and requires 6-7 mins to have a complete view inside the cave.

This 700m promenade and park on the west side of the Imperial Palace is particularly impressive during cherry blossom season, when the around 250 sakura trees reach their heavy branches out over the Chidorigafuchi moat. Chidorigafuchi Boathouse, around the middle of the park, is where to rent a boat and paddle out over the water.

It is said that Chidorigafuchi was named because it has the shape of "Chidori". It used to be connected to Hanzo Moat, but it was reclaimed for road construction in 1883, and the moat was divided into two.Somei Yoshino cherry trees and wild cherry trees are planted on the banks of Chidorigafuchi and Hanzo moat, and together with the cherry blossoms of Chidorigafuchi Park managed by the 23 wards of the upper part of the bank, it is one of the most famous cherry blossom viewing spots in Tokyo.

title: Fuji Safari Park | 富士サファリパーク
description:
#fujisafaripark #fujizoo 

Fuji Safari Park

At the foot of Mt. Fuji lies this enormous animal park. Divided into 2 major zones, the Safari Zone and Fureai Zone. 

Safari Zone is a 50min drive through where you can find 7 zones of different animals from all over the world. Riding on your own car, you cannot open your windows or doors as it could be too dangerous. But there is an option of riding the Jungle Bus where you can feed the animals yourself. these huge animals come to the jungle bus seeking for food, as close as 20cm apart from you, with just steel mesh in between. You can also opt to try their 4WD vehicle and experience the same as the jungle bus, feed the animals as they come near you and wait to be fed.

The fureai zone on the other hand is extremely different as you can have a friendly contact with the animals. you can feed them upclose, hold them in your arms and caress them as long as you want. Great for kids and animal lovers.

description: The tourist spots of Shimonoseki and Mojiko (Kanmon area) connected by the Kanmon Strait are packed into three minutes. It takes just five minutes to cross by ferry, but the atmosphere of each town, while similar, is different. This footage allows you to feel the history of each town, so please enjoy comparing the differences.

title: 小倉城周辺エリア
description: Kokura North Ward's city center features Kokura Castle, Kitakyushu City Hall, and Katsuyama Park. Additionally, the 'Murasaki River' flowing through the city center has ten bridges designed with nature as a theme, symbolizing the natural regeneration of the Murasaki River, blending into the urban landscape.

title: 平尾台
description: Hiraodai in Kokura Minami Ward is one of Japan's three major karsts designated as a national monument, and the landscape scattered with limestone reminds one of a flock of sheep playing in a grassland. In addition, you can enjoy nature at the large park 'Hiraodai Nature Village,' which offers a panoramic view of the magnificent scenery of Hiraodai, as well as limestone caves.

title: 若戸大橋周辺エリア
description: The red Wakato Bridge spanning Dokai Bay and the nostalgic 'Wakato Ferry' are in this area. Once flourishing as Japan's largest coal shipping port, the Wakamatsu South Coast Road features modern architecture such as the Coal Hall and the old Furukawa Mining Building, which still retain traces of its former prosperity.

title: 皿倉山
description: Height 622m of Mount Sarakura. It takes about 10 minutes to reach the summit station from the base station by transferring from the cable car to the slope car. One of the New Japan's Three Great Night Views, the spectacular view overlooking the city and industrial areas is said to be the '100 Billion Dollar Night View.'

title: 門司港レトロ
description: Moji Port, which flourished as an international trading port from the late Meiji period, still retains many retro buildings that reflect its past, making it one of the top tourist spots in Kitakyushu City, attracting many visitors. The sightseeing train 'Kitakyushu Bank Retro Line Shiofukugo' runs between Moji Port Retro and Wabukari from spring to autumn, covering the shortest distance in Japan (2.1 km) at the slowest speed (15 km/h).

title: 長崎街道
description: The Nagasaki Kaido connects Buzen Kokura and Nagasaki. At its starting point, 'Kokura Castle Town', there is 'Tokiwa Bridge', 'Matsunamiki of Kyokuri' which retains the traces of Nagasaki Kaido, 'Tachiba Chaya Ginkgo' which was used as a resting place by various feudal lords and Nagasaki magistrates during the Sankin-kotai between Kurosaki-juku and Kiyase-juku, and 'Kiyase-juku Memorial Hall' which preserves materials from the prosperous post town of Kiyase.

title: 河内・合馬周辺エリア
description: Kawachi Reservoir, located in Yahatanihonmachi, is a reservoir built over eight years starting in 1919 to secure the supply of iron for steelmaking. The red 'Minamikawachi Bridge' in the background is designated as an important cultural property of the country. The Goma area in Kokura Minami Ward has many spots to enjoy nature, such as Goma Bamboo Grove Park, Suga Falls, and Mitake Plum Grove Park.

title: 若松北海岸・グリーンパークほか
description: Wakamatsu Ward's North Coast features the popular Waita Beach for swimming, Marine Park, and Tonda Reservoir. The Hibikinada Green Park, where you can enjoy animals and seasonal flowers, and the Hibiki Animal World, which houses about 300 kangaroos, attracts many families.

title: ANA おとな北宗谷　ダイジェスト編
description: The 'Otona Kitasoya' is a special site featuring Wakkanai City, Rishiri Island, and Rebun Island. Would you like to experience the refreshing season at Japan's northernmost point? Please use ANA flights to reach Wakkanai, the base!

title: 【天城峠】『伊豆の踊子』の物語をたどる旅《東京駅→修善寺駅→伊豆急下田駅》 12/12-101
description: This December, I traveled to Izu in commemoration of the significant changes to the JR Limited Express service to the Izu area starting in March. I wanted to learn more about the Limited Express Odoriko, so I thoroughly read Yasunari Kawabata's novel 'The Dancing Girl of Izu' and followed a journey almost identical to his. The Yugen Onsen 'Fukudaya' where I stayed had the very room that Kawabata stayed in, and the inn itself is a splendid cultural asset dating back to the early Meiji period.

title: 高コスパ観光地 神戸市観光　六甲山・メリケン・布引の滝【スーツ休暇2019その13】東京駅→三宮駅 4/11-101
description: I traveled around various places in Kobe City. I was quite tired, but it was fulfilling. If you are a man, I recommend the capsule hotel in Sannomiya.

title: 【秋葉の火まつり・火防大祭】 in 可睡斎 2015
description: This is the scene of the 'Akiba Fire Festival and Fire Prevention Grand Festival 2015' held at Kasuisai in Fukuroi City.

title: 法多山 尊永寺『桜』2016 - "SAKURA" cherry blossom in HATTASAN SONEIJI-
description: As a famous cherry blossom spot, Hattasan Soneiji has about 500 cherry trees of Somei Yoshino that bloom from late March to early April.

title: 伊勢志摩の桜（ "SAKURA" CherryBlossom in Ise Shima) 2024
description:
The Place where blooming "SAKURA" cherry blossoms in Iseshima.
Iseshima has beautiful spots for cherry blossoms.
We suggest feeling the spring of ISESHIMA with "SAKURA".

title: 【ここ日本？】とんでもない場所にある断崖絶壁の集落…。存亡の危機！限界集落から消滅集落へ…。秘境と絶景に忘れ去られた観光地 / 北海道一周の旅！オタモイ地蔵尊と廃墟（廃村）小樽市
description: This time, we start our journey around Hokkaido! Hokkaido has a scale of nature that cannot be compared to Honshu. We use the Shin Nihonkai Ferry from Maizuru Port to Hokkaido. After a 21-hour boat trip, we safely land in Hokkaido! And the first place we headed to is…

title: 【加速する衰退】観光地があるのに衰退していくレトロな温泉街。景観を損ねる廃墟の悪循環 / 北海道一周の旅！神の子池→摩周湖→硫黄山→川湯温泉→屈斜路湖（野湯）星野リゾート
description: This time, we will visit "Kawayu Onsen" in Hokkaido. Located within the Akan Mashu National Park, it is a hot spring town with the best water quality and many beautiful tourist spots, yet it is declining. The ruins are prominent, causing issues with the scenery. The future development of this hot spring area is a concern.

title: 【加速する衰退】これが奥座敷の今。廃墟と化した現役の温泉街と昭和レトロな町並み。「温根湯温泉」塩別つるつる温泉に宿泊！北海道北見市観光スポット
description: This time, we will visit a hot spring town in Kitami City, Hokkaido. I am at a loss for words at the current state, which is more dilapidated than I had imagined. It was a hot spring town that has become a ruin, not just in decline. The water quality is wonderful, and it is my favorite smooth sulfur spring. I hope everyone can experience this hot spring for themselves!

title: 【断崖絶壁】日本一危険な神社を雨の中攻める！北海道最古の山岳霊場で北海道最西端の「太田山神社」北海道一周の旅！秘境と絶景のパワースポット / 寺社仏閣巡り
description: This time, we will visit the 'Ota Mountain Shrine', said to be the most dangerous shrine in Japan!

title: 【都会の秘境】異世界のような神秘的な穴場の絶景を巡る旅！兵庫県神戸のパワースポット / 仏谷洞窟・勝雄不動滝・堂屋敷洞窟・須磨アルプス登山
description: This time, we will explore the mystical hidden scenic spots in Kobe, Hyogo! I had no idea that such eerily mystical views existed in Kobe...

title: 【予約困難】コスパ最強、全室絶景の露天風呂付き温泉旅館にラウンジ飲み放題&食べ放題ビュッフェ！北海道洞爺湖にある「ザ・レイクスイート湖の栖」
description: This time, I will stay at the hot spring inn 'The Lakesuite Lake no Su', which is located closest to Lake Toya in Hokkaido. All rooms have open-air baths, and the stunning view of Lake Toya can be seen from the guest rooms. The lounge offers unlimited drinks, and the buffet has a wide variety of menus, with the lowest price starting from 26,500 yen per person. Reservations are difficult to make in the near future.

title: 【秘境の一軒宿】秘湯と美食、野生動物に出会える大人の隠れ家 / 北海道観光スポット阿寒湖と奥屈斜路湖温泉ランプの宿森つべつ
description: This time, we will stay at a secluded inn located deep in the mountains of Tsubetsu Town, Hokkaido. 86% of the area is covered by forests, making it a nature-rich place. Wild animals visit the inn, allowing for close observation.

title: 【秘境の隠れ宿】電波の届かない山奥にポツンと佇む一軒宿。源���掛け流し、極上の秘湯！北海道の観光スポットと然別峡かんの温泉
description: This time, we will visit a solitary inn located in a hidden area of Hokkaido. It is a popular hot spring inn among hot spring fans, and you can see why it is so popular with its wonderful hot springs!

title: 【秘境の雪見露天風呂】乳白色の秘湯と信州牛3倍盛りプラン | 雪に閉ざされた小さな温泉地。白骨温泉（長野）と旅館「小梨の湯 笹屋」
description: This time, we will stay at the hidden hot spring area 'Shirakubo Onsen' located in the mountains of Matsumoto City, Nagano Prefecture. It is said that if you soak for three days, you won't catch a cold for three years, thanks to the milky white hot spring. Surrounded by nature, we will enjoy snow-viewing baths and quiet moments.

title: 【なぜ人気！？】廃墟化する温泉街の高級旅館に泊まってみた。巨大露天風呂付客室と日本の風情を味わえる最高の旅館「山荘天水」 と大分県のレトロな温泉街「天ヶ瀬温泉」
description: This time, I will stay at Amagase Onsen in Oita Prefecture. It is a hot spring area with a history of over 1,300 years, one of the three major hot springs in Bungo, alongside Beppu and Yufuin. It is a hot spring town that combines charm and retro feel. However, due to the impact of flooding, many ryokans have gone out of business, and a quiet street lined with ruins has spread. Among them, the hot spring ryokan "Sansou Tensui" still boasts high popularity. We will delve into its unknown secrets.

title: 【なぜ？】観光客がいないけど高評価の宿しかないレトロな温泉街。全室露天風呂付きの絶景旅館に宿泊してみた！秘境、湯布院の奥座敷「湯平温泉」と大分県穴場の観光スポット/湯布院峡谷、龍昇の滝
description: I will stay at Yuhira Onsen, which quietly stands in the mountains of Oita Prefecture. The hot spring town with stone-paved slopes and old townscapes feels like a world from 'Spirited Away.' It is said to have inspired the anime 'Suzume's Door-Locking,' and it retains a landscape of Japan where time seems to have stopped. However, despite such a charming place, there are hardly any tourists. Many reviews are highly rated, so I decided to visit this time.

title: 【加速する衰退】これが奥座敷の今。廃墟とかした時が止まったレトロな温泉街。ノスタルジックで静かな穴場の秘湯で湯めぐり。熊本県「湯の鶴温泉」と旅館「あさひ荘」
description: This time, we will visit Yunotsuru Onsen in Minamata City, Kumamoto Prefecture. In the hot spring town, there are hardly any tourists, and shuttered shops and ruins remain here and there. However, a retro atmosphere that feels like time has stopped drifts, and it is a hot spring town with a nostalgic charm. Please be sure to visit at least once.

title: 【コスパ最強】那須の巨大温泉宿で食べ放題＆源泉掛け流しの露天風呂付き客室に泊まる。温泉、バイキング、懐石料理が楽しめる「ホテルサンバレー那須」栃木県
description: This time, we will thoroughly review the huge hot spring hotel 'Hotel Sun Valley Nasu' located in the great nature of Nasu Highland, Tochigi Prefecture! Enjoy hot springs with free-flowing source water and all-you-can-eat.

title: 【加速する衰退】少しづつ静かになっていく…廃墟化する人気だった混浴温泉街の今。レトロと風情を持つ湯治場 / 長野県観光スポット鹿教湯温泉と「斎藤ホテル」
description: This time, we will visit Shika-yu Onsen in Nagano Prefecture. While many tourist spots are bustling with inbound tourists, we went to check the current state of the hot spring town that is declining due to a decrease in visitors.

title: 【穴場の隠れ宿】山間に佇む古民家造りの一軒宿。これは別格！秘密にしておきたい穴場の秘湯と美食。新平湯温泉旅館「松宝苑」 / 岐阜県観光スポット
description: This time, we will stay at 'Shohoen' located in Shin-Hirayu Onsen, Okuhida Onsen Village, Gifu Prefecture. It is a single inn situated in the mountains surrounded by nature at an altitude of about 1000m, serving as the gateway to the Northern Alps. The building is over 100 years old, and you can spend a quiet time while enjoying the view of the Japanese garden from your room. The dinner is plentiful, and from check-in to check-out, you can enjoy the large public bath and private open-air bath, making it a must-visit for hot spring lovers. There are many popular tourist spots and hot spring areas nearby.

title: 【古き良き日本の温泉街】レトロな温泉街に一際目立つ温泉旅館に泊まる。露天風呂付き特別室と花火が上がる夏祭。鳥取県穴場の絶景スポットと三朝温泉「旅館大橋」
description: This time, I will stay in the retro and small hot spring town of 'Misasa Onsen' located in Misasa Town, Tottori Prefecture. Inns line the riverside, and the hot spring town has prospered as a healing place since ancient times. The nostalgic Showa retro townscape remains to this day.

title: 【穴場の一軒宿】秘境に現れるレトロで静かな温泉街にポツンと佇む一軒宿の露天風呂付き客室に泊まる。有福温泉「旅館ぬしや」と島根県の観光スポットを巡る旅！多鳩神社・石見畳ヶ浦
description: This time, we will stay at the rustic retro hot spring area 'Arifuku Onsen' located in Gotsu City, Shimane Prefecture. The hot spring opened over 1,370 years ago and appears in a remote mountain area. The hot spring town has several day-use bathing facilities and accommodations, where you can spend nostalgic Japanese scenery and quiet time.

title: 【山奥の秘湯】山間に突如現れる、レトロで小さな温泉地。超穴場の絶景と秘湯を巡るノスタルジック旅！源泉掛け流しの美肌の湯「美又温泉」島根県の秘境と観光スポット
description: This time, we will visit the retro hot spring area 'Mimata Onsen' located in Hamada City, Shimane Prefecture. The hot spring opened about 150 years ago and quietly stands in the mountains, with several day-use bathing facilities and accommodation facilities lined up in the hot spring town, allowing for a peaceful time. The mystical hidden scenic spots in the surrounding area are also recommended!

title: 【タイムスリップ】宿場町のレトロな温泉街と神秘的な秘境の絶景を巡る旅。熊本県山鹿市「山鹿温泉」と観光スポット
description: This time, we will visit Yamagakushi Onsen in Kumamoto Prefecture, said to be the birthplace of family baths. It is a hot spring town where culture and history remain vividly.

title: 【加速する衰退】これが九州の奥座敷の今。廃墟と化した秘境の温泉街と昭和レトロな街並み。ひぜんや「杖立渓流の宿 大自然」の特別室に泊まる。熊本県杖立温泉
description: This time, I will stay at Tsuedate Onsen located on the border of Kumamoto and Oita Prefectures. The hot spring town is declining due to the collapse of the bubble economy, a lack of successors, and water damage. It features a unique and retro Showa streetscape that is unlike any other.

title: 【超穴場】ひなびたレトロな温泉地にある、料理のボリュームが異常すぎる温泉旅館！源泉かけ流しの露天風呂付客室の特別室に宿泊。妙見温泉 妙見田中会館と鹿児島霧島の絶景や秘湯の野湯を巡る旅
description: This time, we will stay at Myoken Onsen 'Myoken Tanaka Kaikan' in Kirishima City, Kagoshima Prefecture. The food is incredibly generous! We will also explore nearby tourist spots and natural hot springs! Special room for two adults with two meals included for 48,000 yen.

title: 【加速する衰退】山間にひっそりと佇む時が止まったレトロな温泉街！秘湯と町並みを楽しむノスタルジック旅。鹿児島県秘境の穴場観光スポット「川内高城温泉」
description: This time, we will visit Kawauchitakajo Onsen, located in a hidden mountainous area of Kagoshima Prefecture. It is a hot spring town that is declining not due to the collapse of the bubble economy, but simply due to depopulation and a lack of successors. The nostalgic retro townscape has a unique atmosphere that can only be created by history, and it is a precious landscape that remains today. While we do not wish for it to be bustling, we hope that this wonderful townscape and high-quality hot springs will be preserved for future generations.

title: 【穴場の秘湯】24時間いつでも200円で入れる絶景の貸切温泉！温泉に入るためだけのお馬鹿な大冒険！鹿児島県の穴場の観光スポットと無人温泉「滝の湯」

description: This time, I will travel to Kagoshima Prefecture in southern Kyushu! First, I aim for Kirishima City. As expected in Kyushu, which has many hot springs, there are also wild hot springs ♨️ I am looking forward to what kind of journey will begin 😊

title: 【加速する衰退】これが広島の奥座敷の今。廃墟と化した現役の温泉街。昭和レトロな町並みと源泉かけ流しの露天風呂を楽しむ旅！湯来温泉と湯の山温泉
description: This time, we will visit Yuki Onsen and Yunoyama Onsen located in Hiroshima Prefecture. Yuki Onsen, boasting a history of about 1500 years and known as Hiroshima's hidden retreat, is experiencing accelerated decline, with an increasing number of ruins that mar the landscape.

title: 日本屈指の秘境に突如現れる巨大な温泉ホテル！が気になったから行ってみた。祖谷渓温泉ホテル 秘境の湯と、徳島と高知の穴場の絶景を巡る旅！四国秘湯巡り
description: This time, I will stay at the giant hotel "Iya Valley Onsen Hotel, Secret Hot Spring" located in Iya, one of Japan's three great hidden areas. Before that, I was supposed to tour the scenic spots in Kochi while refueling my gas, but it turned into a great adventure!

title: 【渓谷の隠れ宿】日本屈指の秘境に佇む美食と全室露天風呂付きの温泉旅館！観光スポットと穴場の絶景を巡りながら旅館を目指す徳島県祖谷の旅！渓谷の隠れ宿 祖谷美人
description: This time, we will stay at an inn located in the Iya Valley, one of Japan's three great hidden areas! The Iya area boasts magnificent nature, and the ryokan is a luxurious retreat with open-air baths in every room! The hearty gourmet meals enjoyed around the irori are the best! This is a ryokan you definitely want to stay at 😊

title: 【秘境と絶景】誰もいない穴場、まるで異世界のような神秘的な絶景を巡る旅！内尾神社、白綾の滝、浄丸神社、洞滝/ 丹波と朝来
description: This time, we will visit the mysterious scenic spots in Hyogo Prefecture! We have found many places that are not listed in guidebooks, and we would like to visit some of them.

title: 【秘境と絶景】観光客のいない岩手県の神秘的な穴場の絶景スポットを巡る旅！秘境の洞窟や神社 / 北山浜・滝観洞・不動滝・鵜の巣断崖
description: This time, we will visit hidden scenic spots on the Pacific side of Iwate Prefecture! It is full of attractions such as mystical shrines, interesting caves, and breathtaking cliffs! And there are few tourists (when I went, there was no one) so I recommend it!

title: 【日本屈指の豪雪地帯】なぜ人気！？電気も電波もない、とんでもない秘境に佇む退屈な一軒宿 / 「ランプの宿 青荷温泉」 / 十和田神社・奥入瀬渓流・雪の絶景  青森県観光スポットと秘湯めぐり旅
description: This time, we will stay at the hidden hot spring inn "Lamp Inn Aoni Onsen" located in Aomori Prefecture, one of Japan's leading heavy snow areas. We will also visit tourist spots around Aoni Onsen, such as "Towada Shrine" and "Oirase Stream." At Aoni Onsen, you can enjoy an extraordinary space without electricity and where radio waves do not reach.
